title: Only 2 tests (spec requires >=3), both trivial
evidence: src/main.rs:34 test_model_structs and src/main.rs:77 test_state_clone are the only #[test] fns in the whole tree (grep of *.rs finds exactly 2). test_model_structs asserts struct-field construction; test_state_clone asserts AppState.clone() succeeds. Neither exercises an HTTP handler, DB query, or validation path. No tests/ integration dir. test_coverage=1.0 (scores.json) reflects these 2 vacuous tests passing.
suggestion: Add at least one more test and cover a real path (e.g. actix_web::test against create_book validation returning 400, or a round-trip via the diesel layer).
